cards.name: VBS
cards.description: Vacation Bible School for children, with a program for teens entering grades 7–12. Snacks are provided.

hours.text: Check-in will start at 6:10 every night. Check-out will be at 8:30pm every night.

cards.review_notes: The supplied VBS page gives no year or dates; its undated details are retained as the 2026 fallback. Check the official signup page for the children's minimum grade and summer dates. Grades 7–12 are explicitly stated for teens, and the FAQ specifies entering grades. Check-in at 6:10 is not treated as the program start time. The signup page misspells the address as 'Watuaga'; the church's own website publishes '125 Watauga Rd', which is used here.
